next_steps_if_env_is_missing: If NEWS_COLLECTOR_PATH is null/empty here, then Streamlit is being launched without it.
Kill any existing Streamlit process and re-run `make refinery` from the same shell.
If launching from VS Code, ensure the integrated terminal inherits env or use Makefile inline env prefix.
next_steps_if_matches_found_in_streamlit: If matches appear under ~/.streamlit or ./.streamlit, remove or update those secrets/config files.
next_steps_if_matches_only_in_cache: If matches only appear in ~/.cache, you can delete the specific cache subtree related to the app safely.
